causal_scope: Intervention on the complete history block. Last-LEFT stratification describes donor classes; ten history coordinates move jointly.
consequence_scope: Synthetic histories have no new host rollout or measured reward. Original action rewards are not assigned to counterfactual choices.
controls: Original history and all-ten-coordinates zero; initial policy readout for every intervention.
donor_rule: All training sources with identical sentence_count and target; preserve ordinal order; identity donors are retained. No filtering or weighting by action reward, acquired scores or prior LEFT.
future_question: A separately registered actor-driven rollout will measure actual future consequences under the agent-generated history.
input_scope: 96 previously exposed source states, 12 episodes and two seeds per split. All12donors crossed with each source within matching target/count.
name: SPA frozen-policy history intervention
outcomes: Native scores, score deltas, chosen typed action, action changes, source/donor witnesses and immutable policy/life identity.
question: Does changing the complete captured history block alter native action scores and choices when perception, policy, recipient metadata, mask and RNG remain fixed?
readout_rule: Native score_experience and strict masked argmax; byte-identical original readout required before any synthetic input. Compare whole agent state before/after all scoring.
recovery_rule: Replay exactly24576recorded conditioned updates in registered order; every native fit receipt and original final saved life must match before intervention. These updates reconstruct previously published weights.
